title: Manifest
description:
The complete pipeline manifest parsed from manifest.toml.

Unknown fields in sections with a fixed field list are rejected. Parameter sub-tables
name profile overrides; their contents are checked during manifest validation.

collections.description: The item sets a `scatter` step runs over, keyed by collection name.

defaults.description: Default values applied to all steps unless overridden.

CollectionDef.description:
A deterministic set of items, loaded from one file.

Unknown fields are refused, for the reason
[`Manifest`](crate::manifest::Manifest) gives.

format.description: `tsv`, `json`, or absent to infer from the file's extension.

id_column.description: Which column (TSV) or key (JSON) holds each item's id.

source.description:
The file the items are read from, relative to the input directory or absolute.
Only a leading `${INPUT_DIR}` expands; other engine variables are refused.

CollectionFormat.description:
How a collection file is parsed.

An enum rather than a free string so the accepted set is closed at parse time, and so the
schema `generate-schema` publishes is the same set `Deserialize` accepts.

oneOf.description: One header row naming the columns, then one row per item, tab-separated.
A JSON array of objects, one per item.

message.description: Error message shown when constraint is violated

category.description:
Required free-form label for grouping failures, e.g. `input`, `quality`, or `network`.
The label does not change control flow.

code.description: Unique error name using `A-Z`, `0-9`, and `_`; report it with the stdlib's `die` helper.

exit_code.description:
Process exit code that signals this error (author band: 1..=63, unique).
A step exits with this code to report the error; the engine maps it back.

max_retries.description: Max retries for this error type (overrides step-level retries)

retryable.description: Should the step be retried on this error?

GroupDef.description: Parameter group definition for UI organization.

description.description: Prose explaining what the group contains.

ParamDef.description: A parameter definition from the manifest.

default.description: Base default value, used when no profile override supplies one.

detector.description:
Script under `bin/` that computes a default before parameter resolution.
Explicit or resumed values bypass detection for this parameter. Shared scripts run once
for the parameters needing detection. An omitted answer uses the base default with a
warning; an invalid answer, nonzero exit, or timeout fails the run.
Not allowed on readonly parameters or inside profile overrides. The timeout is
`[pipeline].detector_timeout`.

increment.description:
Required increment for numeric values. Values are anchored at `min` when present, otherwise
at zero: `min = 0, increment = 5` permits `0, 5, 10, ...`.

profiles.description:
Categories this parameter's value maps onto, each naming the values it covers.

```toml
[params.MODE.profiles]
fast   = ["FAST"]
normal = ["NORMAL", "SENSITIVE"]
```

At most one parameter per pipeline declares profiles. Its selected category chooses
`[params.<name>.<profile>]` defaults and bounds on other parameters.

The union of the value-sets must **equal** the parameter's domain: its `enum`, or
`{true, false}` for a `boolean`. No value unassigned, none claimed twice. A parameter with no
closed domain cannot be profiled, since there would be nothing for the union to equal.

Members have the parameter's declared type; a boolean profile can write `fast = [false]`.

readonly.description:
If true, user cannot override via -p or -c.
Value is resolved normally (base default → profile override).

PipelineHooks.description:
Lifecycle hooks for pipeline execution.

Hooks notify asynchronously and their failures warn without changing the run result.
They are outside step selection and are recorded separately from steps. Started hooks
are joined before the final summary, subject to a five-minute timeout per script.
Use a step or teardown step for work whose failure must fail the run.

on_error.description:
A step failed with a specific resolved error: `error_code -> [scripts]`.

Also applies to detector failures with resolved errors. Cancellation does not trigger it.

on_failure.description:
A run failed after the hook lifecycle started, including handled cancellation.
Receives `EXIT_CODE` when known, `FAILED_STEP` when applicable, and
`CANCELLED=1` plus `CANCELLED_BY` when a signal cancelled the run.

on_start.description:
Started after source validation and setup, before detectors and parameter resolution.
Receives run paths but no resolved parameters; steps do not wait for it.

detector_timeout.description:
Timeout in seconds for a detector script; defaults to 60.
Parameters sharing a detector use one execution with this timeout.

min_threads.description: Minimum number of threads required to run this pipeline.

requires.description:
External tools and libraries the pipeline's steps invoke.

Advisory: use `flowrs inspect --check-environment` to check presence before running.
FlowRs does not install dependencies or check their versions.

ProfileOverride.description: Profile-specific override for a parameter's default value and constraints.

Requirements.description:
External tools and libraries checked by `flowrs inspect --check-environment`.
Checks presence through PATH lookup or interpreter import, without version constraints.

python.description:
Python modules that must import, e.g. `["numpy", "pysam"]`.

Import names, not distribution names: `Bio`, not `biopython`.

r.description: R packages that must load, e.g. `["ggplot2", "dplyr"]`.

tools.description: Executables that must resolve on `PATH`, e.g. `["samtools", "bwa"]`.

anyOf.description:
How a step's execution is spread over a collection's items.

Absent means the step runs once. A `scatter` step runs once **per item**, in the item's own
directory, with its own cache entry and its own log.

`Deserialize` accepts both `scatter = "samples"` and `scatter = { collection = "samples" }`. The
generated schema describes both forms. The table permits only `collection`.

collection.description: The collection declared under `[collections.<name>]` whose items this step runs over.

StepDef.description:
A single step in the pipeline workflow.

Unknown fields are rejected.

cache.description:
Reuse this step's results across runs when its inputs are unchanged.

Scalar results use the shared `${CACHE_DIR}`; scattered results use `${ITEM_DIR}` under
that root. Cache markers track the identity described by `cache_key`. A matching completed
entry reuses the existing results without executing the step.

cache_key.description:
Parameters whose values are part of this step's cache identity.

List the non-readonly parameters that affect this step's results. Identity also includes
executable content, input metadata, and relevant upstream identities. Imported libraries,
tool versions, and unlisted parameters are outside this tracking.

depends_on.description: Step names that must complete before this step

exec.description: Executable filename relative to pipeline's steps/ directory

gather.description:
The scattered steps this step consumes the completed results of, as one batch.

Named steps must be scattered. This consumer waits for their item executions and receives
`FLOWRS_GATHER_MANIFEST` listing the batch, without outcomes. It cannot also scatter;
use `depends_on` for paired dependencies between steps over the same collection.

outputs.description:
Expected output files, checked after a successful exit.
Scalar paths may be absolute or use ${OUT_DIR}, ${WORK_DIR}, or ${TMP_DIR}; writing under
${CACHE_DIR} requires caching. Scattered outputs use ${ITEM_DIR}, including when cached.
A missing output converts exit 0 into a failure.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts on failure (0 = no retries).

retry_delay.description: Delay in seconds between retry attempts.

scatter.description:
Run this step once per item of a collection, rather than once.

Each item receives its own environment, log, and optional cache entry. Steps over the same
collection share item directories, so their output filenames must differ.

teardown.description:
Run after the main DAG, including after a step failure. Does not start after
cancellation or setup failure; runs again on resume.

threads.description:
Thread allocation: "auto" (share the available budget) or a positive fixed count,
limited to the run budget. Scripts receive the actual allocation as `THREADS`.

threads_weight.description:
Relative share of the budget among `"auto"` steps ready in the same scheduling pass.

A ratio, not a thread count: weights are meaningful only against the other members of the
cohort, so they scale with `-@` rather than pinning a number. Two ready steps weighted 3 and
1 split what is available 3:1 — six and two threads under `-@ 8`, three and one under `-@ 4`.

Defaults to 1. Weights affect allocations when multiple auto steps are ready together.

Contradictory with a fixed `threads`, and rejected as such: a fixed cost already states the
exact number of permits the step wants, leaving no share to divide.

timeout.description: Optional timeout in seconds. Step is killed if it exceeds this duration.

trigger_rule.description: Trigger rule determining when this step should execute

StepDefaults.description: Default values applied to all steps unless overridden at the step level.

retries.description: Default number of retry attempts for all steps.

retry_delay.description: Default delay in seconds between retry attempts.

timeout.description: Default timeout in seconds for all steps.

ThreadAllocation.description: Thread allocation: the string "auto" to use the CLI-provided thread budget as an auto share, or a fixed thread count of at least 1.

TriggerRule.description: Trigger rule determining when a step should execute.

oneOf.description: All upstream tasks must complete (any state)
At least one upstream task must succeed
At least one upstream task must fail
No upstream tasks failed (success or skipped OK)
No failures and at least one success
No outcome condition after upstreams finish
